About

I’m from Brooklyn, and my path here wasn’t a straight line. I started college as a biology major, stepped away, and came back to Penn State Harrisburg in 2024 to study technology.

I’ve worked through school the whole way, sometimes across several jobs at once. That’s where my habit started: when something is slow and repetitive, I look for a way to automate it. At Lumen it became an AI agent that won the Business Impact Award. At Midtown Property Management it became auto-filled court filings. On my own it became N-CORE, a trading research platform.

I learned finance hands-on, by building pro formas on real properties, sitting in on earnings calls, and testing strategies in code. Now I want to bring that to a data, AI, or operations team in financial services.

N-CORE ⚡

A trading research platform I designed, built, and piloted, May to August 2026.

Friends kept asking me what to invest in. So I built a tool that shows the signal, the entry, the stop, and the reasoning, so they could learn to judge setups themselves.

I wrote the spec for each phase, used Claude Code to implement it, and reviewed every change. FastAPI runs the backend, React runs the mobile app, and AI agents on the Claude API write research memos from Yahoo Finance and Forex Factory data.

My 5 pilot users asked for faster charts and phone alerts, so I shipped a 5-minute refresh and a Telegram bot. Going fully live needed a paid data feed, which wasn’t worth it for a pilot, so I paused it there.

  • Python
  • FastAPI
  • React
  • Supabase
  • Claude API
